This is the English translation of the third installment of the 公有物少女 series by Yukimuramaru. This gallery will be regularly updated until all pages are translated. Please feel free to point out any errors you find; I will correct them promptly.
Support the original author by buying their work: https://dlaf.jp/maniax/dlaf/=/t/s/link/work/aid/yukimuramaru333/id/RJ01381704.html
Support the author on their Fanbox: https://yukimuramarumaru.fanbox.cc/

Public Property Girls 1 (translated by another group): https://e-hentai.org/g/3235723/3ffc3a76ff/
Public Property Girls 2: https://e-hentai.org/g/3559901/a3eb8e308d/

Updates:
2025/12/29: Pages 1-139 added.
2026/05/11: Pages 140-251 added.
2026/05/14: Pages 252-308 added. This part is now complete. Sincere apologies for the irregular updates—college makes it hard to keep up with this kind of stuff, so I only work on it during my time at home. I’ve finished about 90 pages of Vol 3.5, but future releases will be irregular for the foreseeable future. Thanks for your patience and for reading!
